reason: The existing mapping to Article 10(2) of the DORA Delegated Regulation is defensible and complete. The evidence, specifically the text of Article 10(2) and its sub-point (b), explicitly requires financial entities to perform automated vulnerability scanning and assessments on ICT assets supporting critical or important functions on at least a weekly basis, which directly corresponds to the control objective.
applicability_note: This control is specifically applicable to financial entities as defined by the DORA regulation, which mandates these vulnerability scanning procedures for ICT assets supporting critical or important functions.
challenge_comment: The mapping is clear and directly supported by the regulation's text. No challenge is identified as the provision explicitly addresses the frequency and scope of the required scanning activity.
